title: Stay Safe Online Storyboards
intro: Approved 18 Oct 2026 with three changes, now applied (Lesson Blueprint v1.1): Predict cards aren't scored ("Not sure" plus straight to the reveal), every question has at least 3 answers, and one "Try this" wording that suits adults too. Module 1 is being built first.
decisions: **Splits: 10 lessons become 17.** Seven of today's lessons each teach two ideas, so each is split in two. New lessons: `one-password-each`, `strongest-lock`, `scam-calls`, `privacy-settings`, `public-wi-fi`, `take-back-your-account` and `save-the-evidence`. Each lesson is shorter (6–8 cards), but free accounts open 3 new lessons a day, so the course takes more days.

**Four new titles, same ids:** Phishing Emails → **Scam Emails** ("phishing" appears once, as the nickname people hear); Scam Texts and Calls → **Scam Texts**; Apps and Public Wi-Fi → **App Permissions**; Signs of a Hack → **Signs of a Take-Over**.
**Progress:** finished lessons stay finished. Cards that move to a new lesson start fresh there, and the 7 new lessons show as not started.
**Characters:** Mia in module 1; Sam (with friend Alex and cousin Jess) in modules 2 and 3; "you" in module 4's help lessons. One character for the whole course is possible if you'd rather.
**Words used the same way everywhere:** leak (never "data breach"), second lock, passkey, scam and scammer, warning sign, fake Wi-Fi (never "hotspot"), trusted adult, deepfake.
**The course final** keeps testing modules 1 and 4 only, as today, because guests can play it (modules 2 and 3 are Pro).

**New things to build** (in this order): (1) the player's 2nd-wrong step: show the answer and one line, then Continue; (2) a Hook card: a full-width picture, one line, tap to start; (3) answers you tap on the picture itself; (4) a reveal picture for tap cards, after a right answer only; (5) a play mode for the simulator (no goal), plus three picture models (a post spreading to phones, privacy switches, app permissions); (6) new scenes: home screen, sign-in options, social post, café, account settings, phone call (shared by Scam Calls and Deepfake Scams), group chat and the help board; (7) one set of story pictures per lesson. Every card that needs (3)–(6) also has a fallback using cards that exist today.

**One fact checked today:** a password manager is opened with one master password, your strongest passphrase, used nowhere else (cyber.gov.au, 18 Oct 2026). Every other fact, service and number is as already verified in REVIEW.md.
